assertions.algorithm: Invoke the immutable verifier's own `verify` command as a subprocess against the exact bundle root; record its exit status and stdout. This item never re-implements or bypasses that check.
Invoke the immutable verifier's `map-state` command; record its exit status and stdout as corroborating context, never as a substitute for this item's own case-set assertions.

Invoke the immutable verifier's `verify-results` command; record its exit status and stdout. It only re-confirms three stored constants, so this item's own recompute assertions remain the semantic evidence.
Invoke the immutable verifier's `verify-claim-inventory` command; record its exit status and stdout.

Parse every journal snapshot listed in manifests/journal-snapshots.json as JSONL, count non-empty parsed lines per file and in total, and compare the total against baseline.json's physical_jsonl_records. Malformed JSON on any line fails the assertion.

For every parsed journal record, assert its key set is exactly required_journal_keys (no missing, no extra) and assert none of forbidden_journal_keys appear. This is the load-bearing raw-payload-exclusion check F1 named as missing from the immutable verifier.

Recompute the histogram of the `result` field across all parsed journal records and report it verbatim in the report. This is a fresh recompute, not a comparison against a committed classifier (none is committed for this exact histogram).
Recompute the histogram of every entry inside each record's `friction` list across all parsed journal records and report it verbatim.

No committed classifier maps the 591 physical journal records to the 550 classified lifecycle events or to the outcomes breakdown (closed_green/closed_deviations/audit_red/audit_green/blocked/escalated/retry/deviation). These stored counts are recorded as pinned context in the report and are never asserted as independently recomputed or cross-checked.

The corrected 135,110,000-input-token total and its siblings are derived from excluded raw rollout files (hundreds of MB, out of Scope Excluded). They are recorded as pinned context, never as a recomputed or cross-checked semantic assertion.

Assert corpus.json has exactly five cases, exactly the five required case_id values, no duplicate case_id, every case has all schema-required fields, `confidence` is one of allowed_confidence_values, and `kind` distribution matches required_corpus_kinds (exactly one control, exactly four critical).
For every path listed in every case's source_committed_paths, assert the path exists on disk under --bundle-root. A referenced path that does not exist fails the assertion.

Parse every selected-session record; assert its key set is exactly session_record_required plus the already-present evidence_kind field (no forbidden_session_keys), original_sha256 matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}$, timestamp parses as ISO-8601, and confidence is one of allowed_confidence_values.
Assert the case_id set of the session records equals the case_id set of manifests/selected-session-evidence.json equals the case_id set of corpus.json cases, all with cardinality five.
Assert exactly one case has kind == control and its case_id is honest-http-clean-control, matching REQUIRED_CASES in the immutable verifier.

Assert every journal file's sha256/bytes/lines recorded in journal-snapshots.json equals the same file's entry in bundle-manifest.json (both manifests must agree on the same seven committed files, not only the immutable verifier's manifest-vs-disk check).
